-- Phase 2: implementation of checked_add.
-- Returns the sum of a and b, or None when the sum does not fit in int.
-- Overflow never panics here: the caller gets None instead.

checked_add(a: int, b: int) -> int? =
  ex checked_add(1, 2) == 3
  ex checked_add(-5, 5) == 0
  ex checked_add(9223372036854775807, 1) == None
  ex checked_add(-9223372036854775808, -1) == None
  if b > 0 and a > 9223372036854775807 - b
    return None
  if b < 0 and a < -9223372036854775807 - 1 - b
    return None
  a + b
